decision: Evaluate separately recorded SSE transport after repeated non-streaming full-input HTTP failures; first run only one complete frozen N01 trial before any bulk submission.
reason: Transport reliability only; no prompt tuning, semantic-answer change, model change, reasoning-effort change or production-pipeline change.
verified_equal: all 30 case input/prompt hashes and split assignments
separation: All non-streaming records and external initial reviews remain preserved. They are a separate partial transport run, never substituted into or combined with SSE repetitions.

sse_transport.completion: Require a complete SSE [DONE] event and a non-null finish_reason for choice index 0.
sse_transport.retry: Inherit bounded HTTP retries before an accepted 2xx response; never automatically retry any failure after 2xx headers.
sse_transport.timeout: Use the unchanged timeout_ms for blocking socket operations; it is an inactivity timeout, not an absolute generation deadline. Arriving events may extend total elapsed time.
sse_transport.usage: Request include_usage; retain null if missing; reject an unsupported-option error without fallback.
sse_transport.trace: Preserve all received SSE text and its wire SHA256, with existing secret redaction; malformed UTF-8 bytes are backslash-escaped in the diagnostic text.

next_gate: Continue this unchanged transport batch only if the complete-input probe returns; report partial or failed outcomes honestly if infrastructure remains unavailable.
